name: Internet Archive
summary:
The Internet Archive is archive.org, home of the Wayback Machine. The classical-column mark in the tab is the favicon saved-page bookmarks use.

Checked 12 November 2026 against archive.org. HTML came from https://archive.org/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://archive.org/offshoot_assets/favicon.ico; apple-touch-icon → https://archive.org/offshoot_assets/apple-touch-icon.png.

The favicon.ico URL is https://archive.org/offshoot_assets/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 15086 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://archive.org/offshoot_assets/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 png.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: png-180x180-01.png at 180×180 (png, 1313 bytes) from https://archive.org/offshoot_assets/apple-touch-icon.png.
